I've confirmed the two relevant files:

1. **`modules/ui_extra_networks.py`** (line 384): The extra networks sort dropdown is created with `value='Default Sort'`. To sort by date by default, this default value must change (e.g., to `'Date Modified'`), so that when opening the extra networks interfaces (checkpoints, LoRAs, hypernetworks, textual inversions), the date-based sort is selected.

2. **`javascript/extraNetworks.js`**: `applySort()` is currently only invoked via `change`/`blur`/`click` events on the sort dropdown — it never runs on initial load. Changing the Python default alone would not reorder cards until the user interacts with the dropdown. The fix must register the sort function (e.g., `extraNetworksApplySort[tabname] = applySort`) and invoke it when the cards are loaded (alongside `applyFilter` via `applyExtraNetworkFilter`), so the date sort is actually applied by default when opening the interfaces.

No changes are needed in the per-page files (`ui_extra_networks_checkpoints.py`, `ui_extra_networks_hypernets.py`, `ui_extra_networks_textual_inversion.py`) since they already emit the `date_created`/`date_modified` sort keys via the shared `get_sort_keys()`.
